item.title: First day tinkering with the site
item.author: Unknown
item.description:
• Messed with fonts for way too long: landed on Source Code Pro for body text, Font Awesome icons for flavor.
  • Added a profile pic, finally; shrunk some titles that felt too big.
  • Fixed a merge conflict I didn’t see coming, basically I should have pay more attention.
  • Turned the Journal into a real section instead of one lonely page, and wrote a little script to spin up new entries.
  • Fixed the language flags so they don’t dump you back on the homepage anymore.

Good first day.
